# 06-validation

Safety validation, stability, fall and controlled-descent tests, human detection and contact-force validation, E-stop and chain validation, fault injection, cybersecurity validation, test operations hold point, supervised trials.

Standard clauses: ISO 13849-1 §10, ISO 13849-2 §4–§5, ISO 13482 §7, ISO/TS 15066 §5, ISO 13850, IEC 60204-1 §18, IEC 62443-4-1 SVV, ASPICE VAL.1.
